preconditions.description: The length of the strings must be between 1 and 1,000,000.
Both strings s and t must have the same length n.

preconditions.expression: all(c in '01' for c in s) and all(c in '01' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t must consist only of the characters '0' and '1'.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if s.count('1') != t.count('1') else True
postconditions.description: If the number of '1's in s and t differ, output -1 indicating impossibility.
Output the minimum number of operations required to convert s into t.
